needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m and partly blocked
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk on the right side to provide safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Sidewalk obstructed by parked vehicles or stalls
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the sidewalk on the left side to allow for safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the left side footway to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.
Upgrade the informal path on the right side to a smooth, even surface as part of creating a proper footway.

needed.evidence: Crossing hard to see, drivers do not always stop
needed.suggestion: Create a raised platform and add clear signage at the crossing to improve visibility and ensure that drivers stop.

needed.evidence: No kerb ramps at crossing points
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at both sides of the crossing to facilitate accessibility and compliance for pedestrians with disabilities.
